newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Aracruz still a hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Aracruz still a hold.

text.p: -- Credit Lyonnais Securities said in a statement it reiterated its hold recommendation for pulp and paper company Aracruz Celulose SA.
-- It said the firm's 9-month profit of $79.6 million was in line with market expectations.
-- Analyst Matheus Tarzis forecasts a net profit of $106.5 million for 1996 and $90.5 million for 1997.
-- He also said pulp prices would slowly go up after reaching the bottom of the cycle. He projects average pulp prices to reach $520/MT in 1996 and $700/MT in 1997.

-- "At this price level, Aracruz will post lower results than in 1996. We expect the share price to be flat until a major event, such as the announcement of an aggressive investment plan or an acquisition, gives momentum to the stock," he said.
